title: Astragalin mediates the pharmacological effects of Lysimachia candida Lindl on adipogenesis via downregulating PPARG and FKBP51 signaling cascade.
authors: Barge, Sagar; Deka, Barsha; Kashyap, Bhaswati; Bharadwaj, Simanta; Kandimalla, Raghuram; Ghosh, Aparajita; Dutta, Partha Pratim; Samanta, Suman Kumar; Manna, Prasenjit; Borah, Jagat C; Talukdar, Narayan Chandra
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物提取物astragalin通过下调PPARG和FKBP51等脂肪生成转录因子发挥抗肥胖作用，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Metabolic disturbances in different tissue cells and obesity are caused by excessive calorie intake, and medicinal plants are potential sources of phytochemicals for combating these health problems. This study investigated the role of methanolic extract of the folklore medicinal plant Lysimachia candida (LCM) and its phytochemical, astragalin, in managing obesity in vivo and in vitro. Administration of LCM (200 mg/kg/body weight) daily for 140 days significantly decreased both the body weight gain (15.66%) and blood triglyceride and free fatty acid levels in high-fat-diet-fed male Wistar rats but caused no substantial change in leptin and adiponectin levels. The protein expression of adipogenic transcription factors in visceral adipose tissue was significantly reduced. Further, the 3T3-L1 cell-based assay revealed that the butanol fraction of LCM and its isolated compound, astragalin, exhibited antiadipogenic activity through downregulating adipogenic transcription factors and regulatory proteins. Molecular docking studies were performed to depict the possible binding patterns of astragalin to adipogenesis proteins. Overall, we show the potential antiobesity effects of L. candida and its bioactive compound, astragalin, and suggest clinical studies with LCM and astragalin.
abstract_zh: 不同组织细胞的代谢紊乱和肥胖是由过量热量摄入引起的，药用植物是应对这些健康问题的植物化学物质潜在来源。本研究探讨了民间药用植物白花过路黄（Lysimachia candida）甲醇提取物（LCM）及其植物化学物质紫云英苷（astragalin）在体内和体外管理肥胖中的作用。每日给予LCM（200 mg/kg体重）连续140天，显著降低了高脂饮食喂养的雄性Wistar大鼠的体重增加（15.66%）以及血液甘油三酯和游离脂肪酸水平，但对瘦素和脂联素水平无显著影响。内脏脂肪组织中脂肪生成转录因子的蛋白表达显著降低。此外，基于3T3-L1细胞的实验显示，LCM的正丁醇馏分及其分离化合物紫云英苷通过下调脂肪生成转录因子和调节蛋白表现出抗脂肪生成活性。进行了分子对接研究以描绘紫云英苷与脂肪生成蛋白可能的结合模式。总体而言，我们展示了白花过路黄及其生物活性化合物紫云英苷的潜在抗肥胖效果，并建议对LCM和紫云英苷进行临床研究。
